steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Our nationwide schedule accommodates Oak Ridge professionals working in nuclear research, national security, and advanced manufacturing. Attend all sessions, engage with active certified practitioners, and receive your official completion certificate upon finishing.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI using your training completion certificate and documented project experience. Pay the required PMI examination fee directly to the Project Management Institute. Verify all credentials are submitted accurately to avoid delays in exam scheduling.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test for the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—study guides, practice questions, and instructor support—to reinforce course material. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Test on your own timeline at an authorized testing center, bringing valid identification and meeting all proctoring requirements.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you hold the PMP credential for a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or additional PMI activities to meet renewal requirements. Renew before expiration to keep your credential current and competitive in your local market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
